decision_conditions:
<p class="MsoNormal">The proposed use of the caravan is not considered incidental
to the enjoyment of the main dwellinghouse at 55 Shaftesbury Avenue, South
Harrow, HA2 0PL. The unit is intended to accommodate non-immediate family
members and includes two bedrooms, a living space and bathroom indicating a level of self-containment and
residential occupation that goes beyond what is typically regarded as
incidental use. The nature and scale of the proposed use would therefore not be incidental to the main dwellinghouse and as such planning permission is required.</p>

<p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-size: 10.5pt; line-height: 107%; font-family: &quot;PT Sans&quot;, sans-serif; background-image: initial; background-position: initial; background-size: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-attachment: initial; background-origin: initial; background-clip: initial;">The proposal is therefore
not a lawful development<o:p></o:p></span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal">The applicant has failed to provide sufficient information
to demonstrate how the proposed unit would be brought onto the site and assembled and moved off site in a manner
consistent with the statutory definition of a caravan, as set out in the
Caravan Sites and Control of Development Act 1960 and the Caravan Sites Act
1968. In the absence of clear evidence that the structure would be transported
and assembled in a way that meets these criteria, the proposal cannot be
confirmed as a caravan.<o:p></o:p></p><p>

</p><p class="MsoNormal">As such, it has not been demonstrated that the proposal
would fall outside the scope of development under Section 55 of the Town and
Country Planning Act 1990. In the absence of this justification, the proposal
is considered to constitute operational development for which planning
permission is required.<o:p></o:p></p>
description: Certificate of lawful development (proposed): Placement of a caravan with the curtilage of 55 Shaftesbury Avenue.
